# Aspose.Diagram for .NET — Agentic Examples

> 1840 AI-generated, compiler-validated C# examples for the [Aspose.Diagram for .NET](https://products.aspose.com/diagram/net/) API. All examples target `net8.0` and Aspose.Diagram v26.5.0. Every example passes both `dotnet build` and `dotnet run`.
